dedupe_keys.name: hong kong environmental database hked environmental protection department

description: The Hong Kong Environmental Database of the Environmental Protection Department is an online map and data catalogue built around environmental impact assessment. Its layers cover district boundaries; environmental impact assessment and direction applications; sensitive areas under the EIA Ordinance, such as bathing beaches, schools, health care institutions, coastal protection and conservation areas, country parks, marine parks, sites of special scientific interest and residential areas; planning information such as outline zoning plans, graded historic buildings, the Ramsar site and water gathering grounds; air quality projections from the PATH model for 2030, 2035 and 2040 by pollutant and height level; noise layers including traffic flow stations, low-noise road surfaces, noise barriers and enclosures; water pollution load inventories for 2021 and 2041; ecology habitats from EIA studies; and fisheries production. A site analysis tool analyses or compares sites for ticked layers, and downloads need a login. Access to the map is free; no licence is stated on the page read, which links a disclaimer. Caveats: downloading needs an account, and projections come from models, not observations. Coverage is Hong Kong. It supports environmental screening of infrastructure projects, such as roads and drainage works near sensitive receivers and habitats; related records are the Antarctic EIA database and the Hong Kong Lands Department open geospatial data.
